entries.title: CULTIC
entries.definitive_edition: CULTIC: Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: CULTIC: Complete Edition / base game plus Chapter Two DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the definitive route because CULTIC is sourced as a Steam Windows PC release, Interlude is part of the base-game update path, and Chapter Two is paid DLC/Complete Edition content on the same platform rather than a separate port.
primary.how_to_play: Buy CULTIC on Steam for Windows PC, then buy the Chapter Two DLC or the CULTIC: Complete Edition bundle for the full Chapter One, Interlude, and Chapter Two story route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Interlude is an update between chapters, and Chapter Two is DLC; neither is tracked as a separate standalone game entry.
